_about: The 20 live missions of the test account, 2026-11-01 21:00 to 2026-11-02 19:30 Cairo (docs/ROOT-CAUSE.md, section 1). Every value is a stored value read by SELECT: request_text, the plan event's summary, per stage the tool, planned rows, parent, replies_of, engine gaps and engine params (first-page inputs), the plan's replies_status, the result event's rows per stage, and the pipe_new event. Raw pages and delivered files are in storage and are NOT here: a mission whose promise needs them is marked promise.replayable=false with the reason.
